description_en: Queries frequently requested web pages of one or more accelerated domain names on a specified day and sorts the web pages. You can query data collected within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainTopReferVisit获取加速域名某天的热门页面引用次数排名，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-top-refer-visit --domain-name example.com --start-time 2019-12-21T12:00:00Z --end-time 2019-12-22T12:00:00Z --sort-by pv --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainTopReferVisit

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the queried information. Valid values:

traf: by network traffic.
pv: by the number of page views. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值：

traf：流量。

pv（默认值）：访问次数
parameters.name: sort_by
